mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He trusts what was placed in him.
Learn from his step.

He sets out quietly to work.

wait_consequence.text:

Use what is in your hand.

He buries his single coin in fear.

fear_consequence.text:

return.text:
[TODO:es] After a long time he comes back.
"Show me what you have done."

excuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Own Your Work
excuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Each life answers for itself.
Speak for what is yours.

reward_five.title: [TODO:es] Well Done
reward_five.text:
[TODO:es] The first brings ten talents.
"Well done, good and faithful servant."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His joy can be yours too.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Run Your Race
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Faithfulness, not size, is praised.
You will be measured the same.

reward_two.title: [TODO:es] Equal Praise
reward_two.text:
[TODO:es] The second brings four talents.
"Well done. Enter into joy."

small_consequence.title: [TODO:es] All of It Matters
small_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Two talents earned the same words.
Nothing given is too small.

judgment_one.title: [TODO:es] I Was Afraid
judgment_one.text:
[TODO:es] The third holds out a dirty coin.
"I was afraid. I hid it away."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fear was never his master's wish.
[TODO:es] Tears rise for the buried gift.

defend_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Fear Is Not Humility
defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] True humility uses the gift.
It does not hide.

ending.title: [TODO:es] Use What You Hold
ending.text:
[TODO:es] Jesus looks at you and says,
"To everyone given much, much is asked."
